services.name: 22' Pontoon
services.desc: Our pontoon rentals are an ideal option for those seeking a laid-back and peaceful way to explore the breathtaking waters of Okanagan Lake. These spacious and comfortable boats have a capacity of 12 people, making them perfect for family outings, social gatherings, or even a day of fishing. Equipped with all the necessary amenities, our well-maintained pontoons provide a living room atmosphere on the water, allowing you to relax and enjoy the picturesque surroundings. Come and experience an unforgettable pontoon adventure in the heart of the Okanagan Valley with your loved ones! services.desc: Stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) is a popular water activity that involves standing on a large, stable board and using a paddle to navigate through the water. It’s a fun and accessible way to explore Okanagan Lake while enjoying a full-body workout. SUP is suitable for all ages and skill levels, making it a great option for individuals, families, or groups looking to enjoy a unique and engaging water experience.
